blocks.text: LongCat-2.5 是一款原生多模态 MoE 模型，面向长程智能体任务，总参数量 1.6 万亿，每个 token 约激活 480 亿参数。它在 LongCat-2.0 的基础上，将视觉理解与智能体编程能力结合起来，可应对复杂代码库开发、全项目构建、创意设计和 3D 任务。这些能力依托于长序列训练、大规模强化学习、多教师学习，以及面向国产 AI 加速器的基础设施优化。

inlines.text: 除非另有说明，LongCat-2.5 的所有结果均使用
Terminal Bench v4.0 / v2.1、Program Bench、NL2Repo：Claude Code harness（v2.1.280），max_seq_length = 512K；Terminal Bench v2.1 结果为三次独立运行的平均值。
DeepSWE v1.1：mini-swe-agent，temperature = 1.0、top_p = 0.95、max_seq_length = 1M；结果取三次独立运行的平均值。
SWE Atlas - Codebase QnA 与 Test Writing：使用 Claude Code（v2.1.116），由 Claude Opus 4.5 担任评判（三次评判取多数票）；结果取三次独立运行的平均值。
BrowseComp：自研轻量测试框架，包含 Verify 与 Discard-All 模块（Discard-All 阈值为 256K），探索轮数上限 1,024 轮；仅开放
HLE w/ tools：纯文本子集，使用 Claude Code（v2.1.116）评测；最大生成长度 256K tokens。
MCP Atlas：推理强度设为 "max"，temperature = 0.7、top_p = 0.95，上下文 256K。
AutomationBench（公开版 v1.0.6）：全部 600 个公开任务，使用该基准的官方评测代码；temperature = 1.0、top_p = 0.95。
JobBench（Main 65）：Claude Code 测试框架（v2.1.280）；评分遵循 JobBench 官方的 LLM-as-judge 协议（对提交的交付物按链式评分细则打分），评判模型为 gemini-3.6-flash；temperature = 1.0、top_p = 0.95，开启思考模式。
SpreadsheetBench 2：Claude Code 测试框架（v2.1.116），评分遵循该基准的官方协议；Visualization 子集由 gemini-3.6-flash 评判，图表在 Linux 上通过无头 LibreOffice（UNO 对象级导出）渲染，并以纯 Python 的 OOXML/Pillow 渲染器作为兜底。
SkillsBench v1.1（87 个任务）：使用 Codex 测试框架评测，temperature = 1.0、top_p = 0.95、top_k = -1。
VideoMME：每个视频最多采样 2,048 帧（1 fps），每帧最多 256 tokens，开启思考模式，提示词为 "Answer with the option's letter from the given choices directly. You can only answer one letter from A, B, C, or D."。
CharXiv-RQ（w/ tools）与 MathVision（w/ tools）：temperature = 1.0、top_p = 0.95，最大生成长度 131,972 tokens。

blocks.text: LongCat-2.5 对专家权重和激活值采用 W4A4 量化，可在国产 AI 加速器上实现原生 INT4 计算。它借助 FlatQuant 风格的可学习变换，在评测基准上保持了与未量化模型相当的精度。共享的专家输入变换使量化可以提前到 token 复制与分发之前完成，从而让同一份 INT4 表示在通信和计算中复用。变换、缩放、量化和打包的融合算子，加上优化的权重布局以及分别调优的 prefill/decode 流水线，减少了数据搬运和通信开销。

blocks.text: 与 W8A8 MoE 基线相比，在线压力测试显示 prefill 吞吐提升 43.3%，decode 吞吐提升 42.77%，TTFT 降低 15.91%，TPOT 降低 19.72%。分组 GEMM（GMM）算子相比 W8A8 平均提速 1.73 倍。结合 KV cache 量化后，W4A4KV8 的 decode 吞吐比 W8A8KV16 高出 92%。

blocks.text: LongCat-2.5 is a native multimodal MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks, with 1.6 trillion total parameters and approximately 48 billion activated per token. Building on LongCat-2.0, it combines visual understanding with agentic coding for complex codebase development, full-project builds, creative design, and 3D tasks. Long-sequence training, large-scale RL, multi-teacher learning, and infrastructure optimizations on domestic AI accelerators underpin these capabilities.

, native-resolution visual features are converted into discrete tokens and jointly aligned with text in a shared semantic space.
Training combines real-world engineering tasks and reproducible agent failures with efficient rollout strategies and safeguards against reward hacking, improving reliable end-to-end task execution.
Specialized agent, reasoning, and interaction teachers guide the model through
, strengthening multi-turn execution, reasoning, instruction following, and safety.
Supernode-aware parallelism, efficient sharding, and communication–computation overlap improve training efficiency, achieving
86% higher per-device throughput than the DDP baseline

Drawing on community practices, aligned training and inference logic maintains bitwise-identical token log probabilities across training, prefill, and decoding. KV cache optimization and LSA improve serving efficiency, nearly doubling decode KV capacity without increasing TPOT on the tested workload.

HLE w/ tools: Text-only subset, evaluated with Claude Code (v2.1.116); maximum generation length 256K tokens.

CharXiv-RQ (w/ tools) and MathVision (w/ tools): Temperature = 1.0 and top_p = 0.95, with a maximum generation length of 131,972 tokens.

blocks.text: LongCat-2.5 applies W4A4 quantization to expert weights and activations, enabling native INT4 computation on domestic AI accelerators. Using FlatQuant-style learnable transformations, it maintains accuracy comparable to the unquantized model on evaluated benchmarks. A shared expert-input transformation enables quantization to be applied prior to token replication and dispatch, allowing the same INT4 representation to be reused across communication and computation. Fused kernels for transformation, scaling, quantization, and packing, together with optimized weight layouts and separately tuned prefill/decode pipelines, reduce data movement and communication overhead.

Fused kernels for transformation, scaling, quantization, and packing, together with optimized weight layouts and separately tuned prefill/decode pipelines, reduce data movement and communication overhead.

blocks.text: Compared with a W8A8 MoE baseline, online stress tests show 43.3% higher prefill throughput, 42.77% higher decode throughput, 15.91% lower TTFT, and 19.72% lower TPOT. Grouped GEMM (GMM) kernels achieve an average 1.73× speedup over W8A8. Combined with KV cache quantization, W4A4KV8 delivers 92% higher decode throughput than W8A8KV16.
